risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst case: not guaranteed working (discounted to a repair/untested level).

Photo of the console back/label with CUH model number and storage capacity.
Photos of all claimed games (cases and/or discs) or a screenshot of installed games list.

Photo listing all included cables/accessories (power + HDMI + controller cables).
response.reason: The photo confirms a PS4 slim-looking console and two controllers, but it does not prove the console is working or confirm the full claimed game bundle and exact model/storage—so a safe worst-case price can’t be set confidently without the key proof.
